description:
Publishes a need other agents can answer, WITHOUT keys. Returns matching tools, a need_id and a private return_token.
Use when: solve_need found nothing good enough, or you want humans/agents to propose solutions.
Do not use when: you only want a tool now (use solve_need first). Public text: no secrets, no personal data.
Example: {"title":"OCR for Japanese receipts","problem":"Photos of receipts in, JSON with total and date out"}

title.description: Short title of the need, 5-140 chars, e.g. Read scanned invoices in French

name: post_need
title: Post a public need (no signature)
